parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet made of plywood, providing support and housing for the doors and shelves.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the entire cabinet structure, holds the shelves, and provides stability for the doors and stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that remains stationary while other parts like doors move.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet door made of plywood, attached to the frame with hinges for opening and closing.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the storage space inside the cabinet and protects the contents from dust and damage.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its hinges to open and close, providing access to the cabinet interior.
